F1 ARCHIVE-PREDICATE (per-task allowed-state, owner/archive provenance): a COMPLETED manifest task is accepted in EITHER of backlogit's TWO valid archive representations: (a) TERMINAL RELOCATION = a UNIQUE archive record with status:done (explicit archived_status/archived_from NOT required); OR (b) EXPLICIT ARCHIVAL = status:archived + archived_status:done + valid archived_from. BOTH require NO conflicting live queue record. FAIL CLOSED on any OTHER archived status/provenance, duplicates (id in queue AND archive), conflicts (archive alongside live queue, or a live status:done in the QUEUE), or missing/malformed data. F2 OWNER-RESOLUTION / owner-agent recovery lifecycle (hardening H8 on 111-F): NEW width-isolated task 111.006-T (C5, size S / complexity medium) updates BOTH owner agent templates (templates/agents/_stage.agent.md.tmpl + templates/agents/_ship.agent.md.tmpl) to the fail-closed lifecycle: zero-candidate normal startup; explicit operator filename selection (never auto-pick); CheckpointV1 agent-ownership validation vs own role; owner-exclusive restore/resume/prune/RESOLVE after operator confirmation with CROSS-ROLE RESOLUTION PROHIBITED; owner-scoped resolution of ONLY the explicitly operator-selected, ownership-matched checkpoint after a CONFIRMED SUCCESSFUL owner resume (never a bulk sweep); FAIL CLOSED with NO fresh-start fallback. F3 DAG READY-SET (predecessor-finished predicate; CORRECTED - supersedes the prior 'terminals (active/shipped/abandoned/archived)' wording that mislabeled active as terminal/non-blocking): a LIVE queued shipment is ELIGIBLE (enters the ready-set) ONLY when EVERY predecessor is completed in a genuine no-longer-blocking terminal closure with valid shipped/done closure. A queued OR active predecessor is UNFINISHED and BLOCKS its dependent -- 'active' is IN-PROGRESS work, NOT a terminal state and NOT non-blocking. An abandoned, malformed, or unknown predecessor state FAILS CLOSED (still-blocking / not-ready, never casually treated as terminal-ready). The ready-set itself contains ONLY live queued candidates -- never an active/shipped/abandoned/archived shipment even if dependency-free. Folded: 110-F desc/IMPL-PLAN/DoD(5), 110.001-T AC3/AC5 (status-filter + regression 'active predecessor blocks queued dependent')/desc, 110.003-T AC2/AC6 (CLI render), 110.002-T AC1 docs, 110.001-R P2-3/P2-4.
